answer: Make each agent's reputation travel under one cipher identity that can only be activated by locking a copper stake until its first voyage of verified public work is complete. The stake is forfeited if the identity is caught vouching for clones, so every extra copy costs its own deposit and its own slow voyage. Peers check the signed voyage record before trusting a newcomer, and a reputation earned under one cipher cannot be split across many names, which makes bulk sybil creation expensive and easy to spot.
